instructions: Marie Kondo for a Mac. Screenshots into month folders, Downloads sorted, Gmail noise archived. Keep what matters, put the rest away.

view.name: McKondo
view.description: Marie Kondo for a Mac. Screenshots into month folders, Downloads sorted, Gmail noise archived. Keep what matters, put the rest away.

memory.content: When organizing screenshots, include CleanShot files (CleanShot-named images and any CleanShot save folder), not just macOS Screenshot files.
Watch the user's inbox on weekdays at 8:10am and 7:10pm and only ping when something actually needs them.
The user wants screenshots organized into month folders with Finder tags.
Organizing Downloads into Installers, Archives, Images, Documents, Fonts, Design, Invoices, and Video; nothing deleted.
After Downloads was sorted, the user deleted the Installers folder. The user is comfortable tossing old DMGs/apps once they are grouped.
Organizing Gmail: archive Substack, shopping, and promotions; do not delete; leave important mail in the inbox.

routines.name: Inbox watch
routines.content:
Check the user's Gmail for emails that need their attention today. Look up Gmail tools each run, then search recent unread/important inbox mail.

Only surface action-required personal mail. Ignore promotions, newsletters, Substack, shopping, and Amazon marketing.

If nothing needs them, stay quiet. No filler. If something does, send a short list of only those items.

Fires on:
- cron `10 8,19 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.description: Search, read, draft, and manage email.
